name: Metoclopramide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Additive tardive dyskinesia, extrapyramidal symptoms and neuroleptic malignant syndrome (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Dopamine agonists and levodopa (apomorphine, bromocriptine, cabergoline, pramipexole, ropinirole)
key_interactions.effect: Opposing dopamine effects; worse parkinsonian symptoms (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CNS depressants (alcohol, sedatives, hypnotics, opioids, anxiolytics)
key_interactions.action: Avoid metoclopramide or the other drug, depending on which matters more; monitor.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion, quinidine)
key_interactions.effect: Higher metoclopramide levels; more extrapyramidal symptoms (label).
Faster gut transit raises their absorption (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor drug levels; adjust the dose.
Monitor digoxin levels; increase the dose if needed.

key_interactions.effect: Faster food delivery may raise blood glucose (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Anticholinergics, opioids, antidiarrheals that slow the gut
